value.rationale: A one-exceptional-item subclass is a natural first heterogeneous-size departure from uniform goods in an NP-complete freely sequenced cumulative-envy problem. The theorem determines an exact continuum of optima, two universal price/size transition points, parity-dependent scheduling decisions, and a full greedy regret curve, rather than restating an already known three-good counterexample. Its quantitative precision can benchmark extension to several exceptional goods and alternate time objectives.
